This pull request is being closed because you aren't assigned to the issue it links.

Maintainers assign issues so that two people don't work on the same change. To get this pull request reopened, comment on the linked issue to ask to work on it and wait for a maintainer to assign it to you. Then edit the PR description (any edit works) and the pull request is reopened automatically. Issues that our automation is already fixing are not assigned to contributors.

See [Issues before PRs](https://github.com/medusajs/medusa/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md#issues-before-prs) in the contribution guidelines.
